; Wash Cycle G-code
; Based on load_dispense_sequence_910 pattern
; Coordinates: X=136, Y=355, Z=23, Servo=145
; Volume: 910 steps (~0.76ml), Speed: F3000
; Wash pump pulses: 5s ON, 3s OFF (prevents overflow)
; Waste pump: continuous drain
; Generated: 2026-01-14

; ========== SETUP - Move to wash station ==========
G90                          ; Absolute positioning
G1 Z100 F1500               ; Lift to safe height
G1 X136 Y355 F3000          ; Move to wash station XY
G4 P500                     ; Pause for stabilization
G1 Z23 F1000                ; Lower to wash height
LINEARACTSERVOMOVE ANGLE=145 HOLD=500  ; Position pipette servo
G4 P500

; ========== START CONTINUOUS DRAIN ==========
WASTE_ON                    ; Waste pump on (stays on during entire wash)
G4 P1000

; ========== PULSING WASH CYCLE ==========
; Wash pump pulses 5s on / 3s off while aspirating/dispensing

; --- Pulse 1: Fill + Aspirate ---
WASH_ON
G4 P5000                    ; Wash pump on 5 seconds
WASH_OFF

VALVE_INPUT MASK=1111
G4 P1000
M83                         ; Relative extruder mode
G1 E-910 F3000              ; Aspirate 910 steps
G4 P500
VALVE_BYPASS MASK=1111

G4 P3000                    ; Wash pump off 3 seconds (drain catches up)

; --- Pulse 2: Fill + Dispense ---
WASH_ON
G4 P5000                    ; Wash pump on 5 seconds
WASH_OFF

VALVE_OUTPUT MASK=1111
G4 P1000
M83
G1 E910 F3000               ; Dispense 910 steps
G4 P500
VALVE_BYPASS MASK=1111

G4 P3000                    ; Wash pump off 3 seconds

; --- Pulse 3: Fill + Aspirate ---
WASH_ON

G4 P5000                    ; Wash pump on 5 seconds
WASH_OFF

G4 P500
VALVE_BYPASS MASK=1111

; --- Pulse 5: Final rinse + Aspirate ---
WASH_ON
G4 P5000                    ; Wash pump on 5 seconds
WASH_OFF

VALVE_INPUT MASK=1111
G4 P1000
M83
G1 E-910 F3000              ; Aspirate 910 steps
G4 P500
VALVE_BYPASS MASK=1111

; --- Final Dispense to waste ---

; Bayonet Load Tip 1
; Based on Bayonet_load_1 macro
; Loads pipette tip from small_dispenser_box and sets L0Tip1 as active
; Generated: 2026-01-14
; Optimized: Compensates for 2mm right-side-high servo tilt

; ========== MOVE TO TIP PICKUP POSITION ==========
G90                          ; Absolute positioning
G1 Z100 F1500               ; Lift to safe height
G1 X340 Y153 F3000     ; Move to v2 holder position
G4 P500                     ; Pause for stabilization

; ========== ENGAGE TIP WITH BAYONET MOTION ==========
LINEARACTSERVOHOLD ANGLE=100  ; Power on + set angle (no oscillation)
G4 P500                     ; Wait for servo to settle


; ========== TILT BED - RAISE LEFT SIDE 2mm ==========
; Left side motors are stepper_z1 (back-left) and stepper_z2 (front-left)
; This compensates for the right-side-high servo tilt
;FORCE_MOVE STEPPER=stepper_z1 DISTANCE=-5 VELOCITY=5
;G4 P500 
;FORCE_MOVE STEPPER=stepper_z DISTANCE=-5 VELOCITY=5
;G4 P500 

; Oscillate to fully engage bayonet
G1 Z52 F500
G4 P500
G1 Z62 F500
G4 P500
G1 Z50 F500
G4 P500
G1 Z62 F500
G4 P500
G1 Z50 F500
G4 P500
G1 Z62 F500
G4 P500
; ========== RETRACT ==========
LINEARACTSERVOANGLE ANGLE=0  ; Raise pipette
G4 P1500                    ; Wait for servo movement
G1 Z100 F1500               ; Lift Z
G4 P500
LINEARACTSERVOOFF           ; Power off servo (prevent burnout)

; ========== RESTORE BED LEVEL - LOWER LEFT SIDE 2mm ==========
;G4 P500 
;FORCE_MOVE STEPPER=stepper_z1 DISTANCE=1 VELOCITY=5
;G4 P500 
;FORCE_MOVE STEPPER=stepper_z DISTANCE=1 VELOCITY=5
;G4 P500 
; ========== SET ACTIVE TIP ==========
SELECT_TIP TIP='L0Tip1'           ; Set L0Tip1 as active tip

; Tip 1 loaded and active
